main.ID: skip: row identifier; used only as the last sort tie-break
main.NAME: map-main, chart-top, chart-density, table:recent, insight:concentration, insight:status, insight:ev — lot names (places, not people)
main.AUTHORITY: chart-auth, chart-top, kpi:authorities, insight:lrt, table:recent, map-main
main.AUTH_CODE: skip: CBS locality code of AUTHORITY; duplicates the name
main.TRAFAUTH: chart-traf — traffic authority responsible for the lot (Israel Railways or a municipality)
main.TRAFCODE: skip: code of TRAFAUTH; duplicates the name
main.X: map-main — ITM easting, read by GovMap from the datastore
main.Y: map-main — ITM northing, read by GovMap from the datastore
main.PARK_N: kpi:spaces, kpi:median, kpi:train_share, chart-district, chart-top, chart-size, chart-modes, chart-pay, chart-auth, chart-density, insight:concentration, insight:zero, insight:density, map-main
main.DUNAM: chart-density, insight:density — lot area in dunam
main.COMMENTS: skip: free-text survey notes (156 of 186 blank); summarised in the zero-spaces insight wording
main.FLOORS: skip: ambiguous code (1 for 177 lots, -1 for 8 lots whose notes mention underground or multi-level parking, 4 for one); not reliable enough to chart
main.RAIL_MAKAT: insight:train — distinct non-zero station codes = stations served
main.TRAIN_SERV: chart-modes, chart-top, chart-density, kpi:train_share, insight:train, map-main
main.BIC_PARK: skip: filled for 4 of 186 lots (3 of them 0); too sparse to state
main.ELECTRIC: insight:ev — EV charging points, filled for about 20 lots
main.Shape_Length: skip: polygon perimeter in metres (GIS geometry attribute)
main.Shape_Area: skip: polygon area in m²; equals DUNAM × 1000
